g.text: Sensitivity of the incremental port contrasts
Each point is a mean paired contrast across five seeds; bars are 95% t intervals conditional on this dataset and protocol.
F1 and AP are different outcomes and use separate axes. Full-test validation-selected F1 is primary; added sensitivities are post hoc.
Secondary comparisons are exploratory and unadjusted. Agreement in direction does not establish significance or independent replication.
